Kathañca.g: idamāyasmā Ānando “katamo pana so bho Ānanda ariyo samādhikkhandho”ti evaṁ samādhikkhandhaṁ puṭṭhopi ye te “sīlasampanno indriyesu guttadvāro satisampajaññena samannāgato santuṭṭho”ti evaṁ sīlānantaraṁ indriyasaṁvarādayo sīlasamādhīnaṁ antare ubhinnampi upakārakadhammā uddiṭṭhā, te niddisitvā1 samādhikkhandhaṁ dassetukāmo ārabhi.
